spec.summary: In CI, diff a checked-in per-component API snapshot (UniFFI library-mode metadata, Kotlin `.api` files, a Swift API digest) against `main`, and flag any breaking change when the in-progress section of CHANGELOG.md has no bullet for that component under `## ⚠️ Breaking Changes ⚠️`. Suggest adding the entry, or a defaulted field / deprecate-then-remove path if the break isn't needed.
flags: An exported fn, method, type, enum variant or field that exists on `main` is removed or renamed
A changed signature: argument, return or field type changes; a new argument or Record field without a UniFFI default; an enum variant gaining a field (breaks Swift positional destructuring)
A Kotlin/Swift API newly marked `@Deprecated` / `@available(*, deprecated)` (Fenix builds with `-Werror`)
Any of the above with no `## ⚠️ Breaking Changes ⚠️` bullet naming the component
ignores: Purely additive changes: new items, new arguments/fields that carry a UniFFI default
`pub` Rust API that is not exported through UniFFI (in-repo Rust callers are fixed in the same PR)
Docstring-only changes and crates not linked into any `megazords/` crate
spec.escape: The changelog entry is the escape; for a snapshot false positive, regenerate the snapshot and add a `skip-api-check` PR label with the reason in the PR description.
